name: API Forge
summary: API engineering specialist: REST/OpenAPI, AsyncAPI, GraphQL, gRPC, contract evolution and API testing across Java/Go/Python stacks. Requires Python 3.12 exactly — the adapter refuses describe on other interpreters.
appropriate_for: API design and review: REST, OpenAPI, AsyncAPI, GraphQL, gRPC
contract evolution, versioning and breaking-change analysis
API architecture, testing strategy and upstream fact intake (apiforge/upstream-facts/v1)
inappropriate_for: Spark/data engineering — route to the spark-engineering family
platform/IDP or CI/CD estate analysis — route to platform-forge
independent verification of API work — route to forge-doctor-api

install.command: python3.12 -m venv <api-venv> && <api-python> -m pip install --upgrade pip && <api-python> -m pip install "apiforge>=0.1,<0.2" <the-forge>/adapters/apiforge
prerequisites: python==3.12.* (required — other interpreters get a describe refusal)

limitations_note: Interpreter-locked to Python 3.12: describe refuses with a named reason on anything else. Cross-forge intake requires apiforge post-PR-34 main or a published >=0.1 carrying upstream-facts/v1.
examples: review this OpenAPI spec for breaking changes
plan the v2 migration of a gRPC service
analyze an AsyncAPI contract for an event-driven flow
